changes: EP wallet and VIP replies identify their character; stale, missing-owner and disposed-menu responses cannot overwrite balances or retire another exchange receipt.
The network receiver also checks ownership before VIP entity mutation or wallet fan-out; menu-only checks were insufficient.
Final exchange acknowledgements require matching request identity, explicit status, valid balances and the fixed one-way rate.
Pure-world movement checks retain cosmetic ownership while ordinary gear is sold, auction-listed, traded or banked, without EP conversion or added power.
limits: Prepared world/handler and DOM checks, not new Mongo/socket settlement, physical-phone certification or a commerce approval. Existing schema, backup and connected wallet/casino receipts retain their own scope. Complete transfer-path review and sequential version/notes, CI and public acceptance are still required before milestone acceptance. No conversion rate, stake cap, payout, monthly allowance, power grant or purchase method changed.
